draft_en.subject: A budget industrial position next to ORing and Witek for your SI customers
draft_en.body:
Hello ABLELINK team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 28 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the ORing and Witek lines you distribute to system integrators, a budget industrial position, neutral-brand, at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP, unmanaged - model STI-280GE - $46 USD; 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - STI-288GPM - $78.9; Gigabit media converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot - STI-110GE - $26.5. SFPs stay with your current source.

One question: is there a budget industrial position your SI customers ask for that ORing prices too high?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
